response.justification: Bogdan is an accomplished senior/staff-level engineer with 15+ years of experience, strong systems thinking, and demonstrable work on high-throughput, low-latency, event-driven services. However, the role is fundamentally a hands-on C++ engineering position in industrial automation, and his C++ exposure is limited to a ~6-month stint at National Instruments in 2014-2015 and a university thesis project — roughly a decade out of date. His recent decade is almost entirely TypeScript/Node.js/DLang web and cloud product work, with no evidence of STL-heavy development, IEC 62443 / Secure Development Lifecycle practice, MQTT/OPC UA/Modbus protocols, industrial cybersecurity, or Azure. The transferable skills (concurrency, async I/O, microservices, testing rigor, mentoring) are real but would not offset the core technology and domain gap for a mid-senior specialist hire.
strengths: Proven high-performance, low-latency distributed systems work (millions of HTTP req/s, async I/O, fibers, caching)
Strong engineering craftsmanship: TDD, CI/CD, trunk-based development, authored testing tooling and frameworks
Clear mentoring and communication track record — workshops, courses, conference talks, technical writing
concerns: C++ experience is minimal and ~10 years stale; no modern C++/STL or OOP-in-C++ evidence
No industrial automation, IoT, MQTT/OPC UA/Modbus, or IEC 62443 / SDL security background
No Azure or industrial cloud platform exposure; profile is web/full-stack rather than embedded/on-premises platform engineering

key_factors.factor: Industrial automation, IEC 62443 & protocol domain gap
